meta.name: history-portability
meta.description: Import Claude Code or Codex history and move complete CCAM datasets between machines. Use when rescanning provider history, importing a copied directory, uploading JSONL or archives, exporting a backup, restoring it idempotently, or verifying that tokens, workflows, runs, rules, and pricing survived.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 备份并迁移 Claude Code 和 Codex 的历史记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要在多台电脑之间保留 AI 编程助手的使用记录
copy.tagline_en: Back up and migrate Claude Code and Codex history across machines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to preserve AI coding assistant history across multiple computers

howto.what: 此技能讓 Claude 能導入 Claude Code 或 Codex 的歷史記錄，並在機器間遷移完整的 CCAM 數據集。它還可以掃描指定目錄、上傳文件或壓縮包，以及執行備份恢復和數據驗證。
howto.when: 當執行重新掃描歷史、導入目錄或文件、導出或恢復備份等操作時觸發。

say.text: 重新掃描 Claude Code 歷史
導出備份並恢復到本機

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude import Claude Code/Codex history and move full CCAM datasets between machines. It can scan a directory, upload files/archives, do backup restore and data verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when rescanning history, importing a directory or file, exporting or restoring a backup, etc.

say_en.text: Export a backup and restore locally.
say_en.note: Runs ccam export and ccam import-data
